resources.string: For normal phones: after locking, scan for up to 5 seconds. Landscape and a 30°–75° desk tilt must stay stable for 1.5 seconds. Moving or charging an unlocked phone never starts the clock.
Foldable hinge mode remains unchanged. This monitor is only for phones without a hinge sensor.
Monitoring is off. Manual entry and screen-saver setup remain available.
Android did not allow the monitor to start. Retry here while the app is visible.
Monitoring is enabled but not running. Tap Resume monitoring after a restart or system stop.
Monitoring is running; notifications are blocked. The background tap-to-open fallback is unavailable.
Monitoring is running. The current app window can be offered the clock after locking; background use offers a notification.

Choose Linzin Desk Clock in the system screen-saver settings. On supported devices the system starts it while charging or docked; the same posture and charging checks apply. Exit with the top-right button or a long swipe up from the bottom edge.

Android and manufacturer power rules can prevent automatic display or sensor delivery. A foreground notification keeps monitoring visible; it does not grant background launch permission. No root, Shizuku, overlays or accessibility access is required. Unlock before the next attempt after exiting.

No gravity or accelerometer sensor is available. Automatic posture detection cannot run on this device.
